instagram.caption:
The best-before you keep arguing with.
The Canned and Jarred Goods in the Pantry. Holds the cans and jars that turn an empty-fridge week into dinner.

What done looks like:
1. Cans sit in rows on risers with every label facing you: tomatoes together
2. Soup together. No dented seams
3. No domed lids
4. No jar hidden behind another jar

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success canned and jarred goods.
